newsitem.title: USA: May & Speh sees FY97 Q1 EPS $0.08-$0.10.
newsitem.headline: May & Speh sees FY97 Q1 EPS $0.08-$0.10.

text.p: May & Speh Inc said Wednesday it expects to report earnings per share of $0.08 to $0.10 a share for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 ended December 31, 1996. In the same year-earlier period, it reported earnings of $0.08 a share.

It said it expects revenues of between $21 million and $21.5 million compared to $16 million in the first quarter of fiscal 1996. It attributed its expected 1997 first-quarter performance to softness in the company's revenues from credit card issuers.
May & Speh said it is scheduled to release its earnings data on January 23.
The company provides computer-based information management services mainly for clients with significant direct marketing requirements.
